name: Ravion
line: Deploy apps and infrastructure into your AWS account.

free.text: Free Individual: 1 user, 50 modules, 2,000 pipeline min/mo

cells.regions: Choose AWS region; Ravion control-plane region unlisted
cells.selfhost: Yes; Enterprise on-prem only, custom pricing

work.math: 100 build minutes fit within the 10,000-minute allowance. The $5 module is offset by a $25 monthly module credit. AWS S3, CloudFront and transfer costs are separate.
$30 container module + $0 for CI included − $25 credit = $5 Ravion cost. AWS compute and data sent out are billed separately, so the workload total is not published.
$30 container + $5 RDS − $25 credit = $10 Ravion cost. AWS database, storage, backups, traffic and app compute are separate.
